takenRequests.title: Conditioning plan
takenRequests.description: Complete three conditioning sessions and review your recovery and sleep.

takenRequests.title: Disciple entry trial
takenRequests.description: Complete a focused disciple commission. Understand Christian Scripture, pray, and put faith into practical service.
checklist: Complete focused practice using the class’s real-world goal
Demonstrate recall, application, or feedback without copying a solution
Review the result and choose a specific next progression

takenRequests.title: Disciple commission
takenRequests.description: Read a short Bible passage in its chapter context. Write its main point in your own words, identify who is speaking and to whom, then check your summary against the text. Finish with prayer and one practical application to revisit. Record the passage and summary.

takenRequests.title: Scripture and service
takenRequests.description: Study a Bible chapter and complete one practical act of service.

takenRequests.title: Disciple training adventure
takenRequests.description: Build a sustainable month of disciple practice. Complete each milestone before claiming the adventure.

takenRequests.title: Healer entry trial
takenRequests.description: Complete a focused healer commission. Study the Bible, practice compassion, and serve people consistently.
checklist: Complete focused practice using the class’s real-world goal
Demonstrate recall, application, or feedback without copying a solution
Review the result and choose a specific next progression

takenRequests.title: Healer training adventure
takenRequests.description: Build a sustainable month of healer practice. Complete each milestone before claiming the adventure.

takenRequests.title: Healthcare portfolio commission
takenRequests.description: Create an evidence-based care-learning project with sources, communication materials, and a review.
checklist: Define the project and acceptance criteria
Save evidence and review the result

takenRequests.title: Scripture and service
takenRequests.description: Study a Bible chapter and complete one practical act of service.

takenRequests.title: Healthcare field assignment
takenRequests.description: Complete three focused practice sessions. Create an evidence-based care-learning project with sources, communication materials, and a review.

takenRequests.title: Healer commission
takenRequests.description: Read a short Bible passage in its chapter context. Write its main point in your own words, identify who is speaking and to whom, then check your summary against the text. Finish with prayer and one practical application to revisit. Record the passage and summary.

takenRequests.title: Healthcare practice
takenRequests.description: Work independently on Healthcare using a written case, simulation, or practical exercise. Check the result against a source or marking guide and record one correction.

takenRequests.title: Profession practice
takenRequests.description: Spend 20 focused minutes developing your registered nurse practice. Record what you learned.

takenRequests.title: Walk for 5 minutes
takenRequests.description: Walk at a comfortable pace for five minutes.
